name: Quikrete Premium Play Sand (50 lb bag)
note: Dry sand poured into the gap between two printed walls. Density derived from a retailer's line that a 50 lb bag fills about 1/2 cubic foot. Sand settles under vibration and needs a dry fill; top it up and seal the opening.

source.title: Town & Country Hardware listing, Quikrete 1113-51 Play Sand 50 lb

loss_factor_source.title: Tom Irvine, Damping Properties of Materials, Revision D (Vibrationdata, 2010-07-02), Table 7
loss_factor_source.note: Table 7 gives 'Sand, dry' a loss factor of 0.06 to 0.12; the record holds the middle. It is the loss of sand itself, not of a measured sand-filled wall.
